# RESULT AND DISCUSSION

## Antimicrobial activity.

Derivatives of 1-methyl-4(5-(4-(phenyl amino) phenyl)-1, 3,4-thiadiazol-2-e thiosemicar bazide (2a-f)were reacted with corresponding reactant dimity lamina, morph line and piper dine (a-c) in the presence of formaldehyde and concentrated acid. All synthesized compounds were obtained in the range of 57.41-66.7%yield. Purity and homogeneity of the synthesized compound were routinely checked by sharp melting point and TLC. The highest activity was observed with 8c (with 69.56% inhibition). Against *K. pneumoniae* the compound 3b (65.21%),4c(60.86% inhibition), 5a (60.86% inhibition), 7a (65,21% inhibition), 7b (65.21% inhibition) and 7c (65.21% inhibition) exhibited good activity. The compound 3a (68.42% inhibition), 5a (73.68% inhibition), 5c (63.15 inhibition), 6b, 7b (each with 63.15% inhibition) and 8a (68.42% inhibition) showed excellent activities.
